name: SUwUcide Hotline
source:
In the game you play as a corporate cat-girl working on a suicide hotline in a dystopian cyberpunk world. The main gameplay consists of talking to your clients and trying to save them or *maybe* achieve some other dirty corporate goals. 

[From [url=https://olshenua.itch.io/suwucide-hotline]Itch.io[/url]]
